message.content: In European populations, the allele frequency of the APOE variant **rs7412** (which defines the ε2 allele) is roughly **15 %** (about 0.15). This estimate comes from large-scale population genetics databases such as gnomAD (v2.1.1), which aggregates sequencing data from thousands of individuals of European ancestry.
